reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is to audit DeepSeek Harness agent implementations by running configurable harness-evaluation checks and producing local reports, as shown by the `/harness-audit` command surface, defined check matrix, and report outputs. It is an analysis and diagnostics tool for project quality/stability rather than a content generator or integration gateway, with behavior centered on code-targeted validation and subagent-driven checks.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供 /harness-audit 命令，用于按维度审计代理循环稳定性问题并输出本地审核报告。
summaries.en: This plugin adds /harness-audit commands in DeepSeek Harness to run configurable harness checks and generate local audit reports for review.

capabilities: Automated inspection of project code for harness-failure-mode checks
Per-check subagent fan-out execution model for audit dimensions
Evidence-gated finding submission with file/path/line validation
Command-driven asynchronous job execution for long-running audits
Generation of markdown and JSON audit reports in workspace output directory
